correctness.rationale: Deletion-shadow incidence A_{y,x} is exactly 1 for a distinct one-deletion descendant; max code size with each row sum <=L is an unrelaxed 0-1 integer program over all 128 columns and 64 rows (n=7). Independently constructed insertion and deletion incidences coincide and every received word has n+1 one-insertion supersequences. The assigned source verifier checks the stored 7-bit witnesses for L=1..8; independently solved integer programs returned feasible integer optimum vectors at each L. Independent SciPy/HiGHS binary-variable MILP reruns proved optima 16,33,50,65,81,96,112,128 with solver-reported optimality and integrality; similarly n<=6 M1/M2 pairs 1/2,2/3,2/4,4/7,6/12,10/19. Thus n=7 first with M(7,2)>2M(7,1); a 33-word list-two code cannot be a union of two list-one codes. Upper bounds rely on trusted solver termination/dual bound; no separate human-readable integer branch certificate.
